# ADR-NNNN: Decision title

- Status: Proposed
- Date: YYYY-MM-DD
- Owners: discipline or people accountable

## Context

Describe the concrete forces, constraints, evidence, and problem. State why a repository-wide or difficult-to-reverse decision is needed now.

## Decision

State the chosen rule precisely enough that implementation and review can identify compliance.

## Rationale

Explain why the decision best serves the product pillars and current evidence.

## Alternatives considered

### Alternative name

Describe benefits, costs, and why it was not selected.

## Consequences

List positive results, accepted costs, new constraints, migration work, and follow-up responsibilities.

## Validation

Name the prototype, tests, measures, and milestone gate that can confirm or overturn the decision.
